plot_hooks.title: Employment by Veradda Stoor
plot_hooks.summary: The adventurers are contacted to aid famed treasure hunter Veradda Stoor in retrieving ancient dragon cultist treasure caches in the Greypeak Mountains.
plot_hooks.how_party_learns: Players receive word through their faction, rumors, or a notice to meet Veradda at a clearing east of the village of Parnast.
plot_hooks.dm_notes: Establish strong adventurer motivation, tie in faction interest if appropriate.

thread_missing_veradda.title: The Fate of Veradda Stoor
thread_missing_veradda.description: Adventurers arrive to meet Veradda Stoor, finding her dead and her notes partially stolen.
thread_missing_veradda.hook: Veradda's mysterious death and missing notes kick off the search for the dragon cultist caches.
thread_missing_veradda.current_objective: Find clues about Veradda's murder and recover her notes and treasure locations.
thread_missing_veradda.next_milestone: Locate the first treasure cache using recovered notes.

player_knowledge.known_to_players: Veradda was murdered and her notes are torn; remaining notes point to five treasure sites.
player_knowledge.truth_hidden: Giants and their agents killed her after learning of her knowledge from another source.

success_conditions: Party examines Veradda's body and recovers clues and backup notes.
failure_conditions: Party ignores murder or fails to gather her extra notes.
thread_missing_veradda.dm_notes: This sets the stage for all five mini-adventures. Emphasize clues at the scene, hint at giant involvement.

thread_cult_treasures.title: Caches of the Cult of the Dragon
thread_cult_treasures.description: Five caches of treasure were hidden across the Greypeak Mountains by the defeated Cult of the Dragon.
thread_cult_treasures.hook: Recovered notes and scrolls identify the locations of ancient caches.
thread_cult_treasures.current_objective: Travel to each cache site and solve its challenges.
thread_cult_treasures.next_milestone: Secure treasures in all five sites.

player_knowledge.known_to_players: The party has clues to five cult caches. Each site presents unique challenges.
player_knowledge.truth_hidden: Giants and rival factions seek the caches for their own ambitions.

success_conditions: Locate and survive all five cache sites.
Secure at least one significant treasure for the party or their patrons.
failure_conditions: Party is driven out or killed before accessing any cache.
Rivals claim all caches before the party.
thread_cult_treasures.dm_notes: The main structure: present mini-adventures sequentially or as time allows.

thread_competing_giants.title: Giant Rivalries
thread_competing_giants.description: With the Ordning shattered, various giant clans (hill, frost, fire, stone, storm) compete for power and seek treasures to bolster their status.
thread_competing_giants.hook: Signs of giant interference at cache sites and reports of giant activity in the region.
thread_competing_giants.current_objective: Survive giant plots and possibly ally with or avert disaster from the giants.
thread_competing_giants.next_milestone: Encounter a giant or witness evidence of giant intervention.

player_knowledge.known_to_players: Numerous signs point to giant involvement and rivalry for treasures.
player_knowledge.truth_hidden: Each clan seeks to outdo the others, sometimes using minions (goblins, kobolds, cultists).

success_conditions: Players survive encountering giants or their minions.
Potential alliance with Kraddokk the storm giant.
failure_conditions: Party is targeted by giants for theft or desecration.
thread_competing_giants.dm_notes: Introduce giant agents or direct intervention as the story progresses, and adjust party standing based on their choices.

loc_parnast_region.name: Parnast Region
loc_parnast_region.dm_notes: Region is a springboard point; adjust relative distances as needed for pacing.

loc_beneath_the_hills_cave.name: Cave Beneath the Hills
loc_beneath_the_hills_cave.dm_notes: Danger escalates with time due to curse effects. Adjust tunnel stability or loot as appropriate.

loc_upon_the_stones_field.name: Stone Field and Boulder Pyramid
loc_upon_the_stones_field.dm_notes: The galeb duhr can provide helpful clues if befriended. The kobold tunnel is small—restrict to small creatures.

loc_against_the_frost_mountain.name: Green-Sided Mountain
loc_against_the_frost_mountain.dm_notes: Emphasize cold, treacherous footing, and cursed magic. Let traps set tone of tension.

loc_through_the_fires_outpost.name: Abandoned Dwarven Outpost
loc_through_the_fires_outpost.dm_notes: Fire creatures can appear over time; Immix glyph is a threat until deactivated.

loc_above_the_clouds_shrine.name: Shrine Above the Clouds
loc_above_the_clouds_shrine.dm_notes: Riddles and moral choices prominent. Adjust giant's attitude and potential for alliance or curse depending on actions.

area_clearing.name: Clearing Outside Parnast

description.read_aloud: You arrive at a well-trodden clearing east of Parnast. Blood stains and footprints mar the ground, and the wind carries a scent of death.
description.summary: Meeting site for Veradda Stoor, discovery of murder, and recovery of backup notes.

area_clearing.dm_notes: Maximize slow build of suspense and clue-gathering.

area_beneath_the_hills_entrance.name: Cave Entrance - Beneath the Hills

description.read_aloud: Outside the opening, the adventurers see a variety of obvious tracks. The tunnel is dark and chilly.
description.summary: Entrance tunnel, tracks reveal goblin, giant, and bear recent activity.

area_beneath_the_hills_entrance.dm_notes: Note tracks and encourage player investigation.

area_beneath_the_hills_cavern.name: Main Cavern - Beneath the Hills

description.read_aloud: The large cavern is empty of living creatures, with several lanterns lighting piles of rubble. Two tunnels exit: one clear south, one collapsed east.
description.summary: Arena for first goblin fight, evidence of sabotage, giant's feet in rubble.

area_beneath_the_hills_cavern.dm_notes: Introduce goblin surliness and clues about the collapse. Reduce goblin count for weak parties or add for strong.

area_beneath_the_hills_south_tunnel.name: Southern Tunnel - Beneath the Hills

description.read_aloud: A scurrying sound and high-pitched squeaking echo from the south tunnel—a wave of mouse-sized goblins swarms toward you!
description.summary: Swarms of cursed goblins, darkness falls as lanterns are extinguished.

area_beneath_the_hills_south_tunnel.dm_notes: Goblins attack with initiative, corpses grow to normal size after death, creating difficult terrain.

area_beneath_the_hills_final_chamber.name: Final Chamber - Beneath the Hills

description.read_aloud: A small creature with a giant's face stands in front of a massive stone chest—Slayermighty the giant, shrunken by a curse.
description.summary: Home of Slayermighty (cursed giant), Blooddrinker the bear, runed stone chest.

area_beneath_the_hills_final_chamber.dm_notes: Saving Blooddrinker is a story award. Important narrative for the giant rivalry. Shrunken status temporary for giant, but permanent for bear.

area_stone_field.name: Stone Field - Upon the Stones

description.read_aloud: You see a massive boulder pyramid at the far end of a flat stone field riven with deep gouges.
description.summary: Approach to pyramid, combat with giant badgers concealed in the gouges.

area_stone_field.dm_notes: Handle animal can pacify badgers; wisdom roll needed for temporary truce.

area_boulder_pyramid_base.name: Base of Boulder Pyramid

description.read_aloud: Enormous boulders fused with elemental magic form the base. Runes are inscribed throughout.
description.summary: Base climb and interaction possibility with galeb duhr siblings.

area_boulder_pyramid_base.dm_notes: Friend of Prrrt award if players assist galeb duhr.

area_boulder_pyramid_top.name: Apex of Boulder Pyramid

description.read_aloud: At the pyramid summit, a stone giant corpse blocks the runed entry. Arcane riddle awaits.
description.summary: Necromantic trap, passphrase puzzle, access to partially looted cache.

puzzles.puzzle: Passphrase required to enter—'HAIL DRAGON QUEEN'

area_boulder_pyramid_top.dm_notes: If players struggle with puzzle, provide dragon cult clues.

area_frost_secret_path.name: Secret Path - Against the Frost

description.read_aloud: A narrow ledge halfway up a green-sided mountain, steep and frigid with deadly drop to one side.
description.summary: Path to secret doors; searching triggers rockslide or glyph trap.

area_frost_secret_path.dm_notes: Rockslide can be used to hasten entry or add urgency.

area_frost_main_chamber.name: Icy Chamber - Against the Frost

description.read_aloud: A massive chamber with an icy floor. Two dead frost giants and a supernatural diamond atop a pedestal.
description.summary: Greed cursed diamond, greed motes attack, saving throws required.

area_frost_main_chamber.dm_notes: Make the supernatural link between diamond and motes clear; shattering diamond is key to succeed.

area_fires_entry.name: Entryway - Through the Fires

description.read_aloud: The party enters ancient dwarven stone halls, dust and fresh footprints marking recent passage.
description.summary: Leads to sentry room with kobolds and evidence of fighting.

area_fires_entry.dm_notes: Can introduce signs of kobold presence or magmin scorch marks.

area_fires_sentry_room.name: Sentry Room - Through the Fires

description.read_aloud: Kobolds fortify barricades against the southern corridor, central stone sentinel post with hidden door.
description.summary: Initial NPC negotiation or combat, clues to fire giants, magic items offered by kobolds.

area_fires_sentry_room.dm_notes: Kobolds will parley if overwhelmed. Offer deals to ensure survival.

area_fires_forge_room.name: Forge Room - Through the Fires

description.read_aloud: Glowing lava river splits the floor, smoky pits and erupting Immix symbol on far wall.
description.summary: Fight with magmin, deactivate Immix glyph through multi-step ritual, retrieve melted silver.

area_fires_forge_room.dm_notes: Magmin respawn if Immix glyph not deactivated. Silver is hard to retrieve before deactivation.

area_clouds_path.name: Cloud Path - Above the Clouds

description.read_aloud: Ascending the Greypeak's highest slopes, you pass through cloud banks to see a brass bell and cave entrance.
description.summary: Approach to the temple, giant owl attack, bell riddle to enter.

puzzles.puzzle: Answer bell riddle to bypass force barrier

area_clouds_path.dm_notes: Adventurer with giant language can read mantras; ringing bell unsolved is dangerous.

area_clouds_shrine_interior.name: Shrine Interior - Above the Clouds

description.read_aloud: Enormous cavern, four tarnished copper braziers, ancient slab, faded mural. Braziers ignite with elemental guardians.
description.summary: Ice and steam mephit fight, loot dead cultists, interact with storm giant Kraddokk upon exit.

area_clouds_shrine_interior.lighting: dim (braziers flare to bright during fight)
area_clouds_shrine_interior.dm_notes: Giants may react to theft of plates; conversation with Kraddokk sets up future adventures or campaign consequences.

item_notes_veradda.name: Veradda Stoor's Notes
item_notes_veradda.description: Original notes regarding the five Cult of the Dragon treasure caches.
item_notes_veradda.lore: Notes compiled by Veradda, renowned treasure hunter.
item_notes_veradda.dm_notes: Players must recover to begin the adventure. Partial, as some pages are missing.

item_scrolls_veradda.name: Backup Scrolls of Cache Directions
item_scrolls_veradda.description: Copy of cache locations, including cryptic clues and mission notes.
item_scrolls_veradda.acquisition_method: Found on Veradda's person after her death.
item_scrolls_veradda.quest_significance: Ensures adventure can proceed after her murder.

item_alchemists_fire_1.name: Alchemist's Fire (Vial 1)
item_alchemists_fire_1.description: A sticky, ignitable substance in a glass vial.
item_alchemists_fire_1.dm_notes: Two vials total in goblin fight.

item_alchemists_fire_2.name: Alchemist's Fire (Vial 2)
item_alchemists_fire_2.description: A sticky, ignitable substance in a glass vial.

item_potion_healing.name: Potion of Healing
item_potion_healing.description: A magical potion that restores hit points.

item_necklace_copper_charms.name: Necklace of 20 Copper Charms
item_necklace_copper_charms.description: A necklace worn by Slayermighty, the giant.
item_necklace_copper_charms.lore: Possibly a tribal trophy or keepsake.

item_ledger_dragon_cult.name: Cult of the Dragon Ledger
item_ledger_dragon_cult.description: A book listing names/locations of secret cult members, partially ruined by acid.
item_ledger_dragon_cult.lore: Marks traitors and allies of the dragon cult.
item_ledger_dragon_cult.acquisition_method: Recovered from secret cache in pyramid; may be damaged.
item_ledger_dragon_cult.dm_notes: Reduce value by 25 gp per failed trap disarm.

item_stone_giant_nose_ring.name: Stone Giant Nose Ring
item_stone_giant_nose_ring.description: A massive silver ring worn by the dead giant.

item_scroll_comprehend_languages.name: Scroll of Comprehend Languages
item_scroll_comprehend_languages.description: Spell scroll granting the spell comprehend languages.

item_topaz.name: Topaz
item_topaz.description: A cut gemstone offered by kobolds.
item_topaz.acquisition_method: Bribed from kobolds in exchange for safe passage.

item_scroll_disguise_self.name: Scroll of Disguise Self
item_scroll_disguise_self.description: Spell scroll of disguise self, useful for infiltration.

item_melted_silver.name: Melted Silver Ingot
item_melted_silver.description: Large lump of silver scorched by fire magic.
item_melted_silver.acquisition_method: Recovered from forge room by surviving fire and magmin.

item_giant_coins.name: Giant Gold Coins
item_giant_coins.description: Oversized gold coins taken from the frost giant bodies.

item_diamond_dust.name: Diamond Dust
item_diamond_dust.description: Residual magical dust from shattered greed diamond.

item_potion_healing_1.name: Potion of Healing
item_potion_healing_1.description: Healing potion recovered from giant corpse.

item_potion_healing_2.name: Potion of Healing
item_potion_healing_2.description: Healing potion recovered from giant corpse.

item_cultist_loot.name: Dragon Cultist Loot
item_cultist_loot.description: Coins, gems, and jewelry taken from the slain cultists’ bodies.
item_cultist_loot.acquisition_method: Looted from cultist corpses at shrine.

item_potion_healing_3.name: Potion of Healing
item_potion_healing_3.description: Healing potion found in shrine loot.
item_potion_healing_3.acquisition_method: Loot from cultists or given by Kraddokk.

npc_veradda_stoor.name: Veradda Stoor
npc_veradda_stoor.appearance: Weathered, sharp-featured woman. Practical travel clothes, light armor, and various pouches.
npc_veradda_stoor.voice: Confident and rapid, lightly accented from long travel.
secrets: Had backup cache notes hidden on her for safety.

knowledge_of_threads.thread_missing_veradda: Knew she was being watched by rival parties.
knowledge_of_threads.thread_cult_treasures: Primary source for all five caches.
knowledge_of_threads.thread_competing_giants: Suspected giants were now involved in cult treasure hunts.

information_can_provide: Worry about giant and cult activity
npc_veradda_stoor.dm_notes: Veradda's murder is the inciting incident. Present body and clues early.

npc_slayermighty.name: Slayermighty
npc_slayermighty.appearance: Hill giant, now goblin-sized, in furs wielding a club; rough, wild hair.
npc_slayermighty.voice: Deep, echoing rants, slips into Giant curses.
secrets: Serves competing giants against other clans.
npc_slayermighty.motivation: Regain full stature and prove dominance.

knowledge_of_threads.thread_cult_treasures: Knows caches exist, desperate to claim first.
knowledge_of_threads.thread_competing_giants: Acts as pawn in giant rivalry.

npc_slayermighty.dm_notes: Plays up giant ego even when tiny. Rants about greatness during and after combat.

npc_blooddrinker_bear.name: Blooddrinker
npc_blooddrinker_bear.appearance: Tiny black bear the size of a housecat.
secrets: Curse is permanent unless cured; will die unless treated
npc_blooddrinker_bear.dm_notes: If rescued, becomes a story award pet. Emphasize helplessness; DC 10 Medicine or Arcana to save.

npc_gggrkk_galebduhr.name: Ggrrkk
npc_gggrkk_galebduhr.appearance: Stone boulder with an expressive face and limbs.
npc_gggrkk_galebduhr.motivation: Guard the pyramid, interact with passersby.

knowledge_of_threads.thread_cult_treasures: Knows caches built, cultists worked with a dragon.

npc_gggrkk_galebduhr.dm_notes: Use for vital clue distribution if players stall on puzzle.

npc_prrrt_galebduhr.name: Prrrt
secrets: Beetle infestation can be fixed by intelligent adventurer.
information_can_provide: Puzzle hint if aided: the giant's passphrase was incorrect.
npc_prrrt_galebduhr.dm_notes: DM awards Friend of Prrrt story if helped.

npc_kraddokk.name: Kraddokk
npc_kraddokk.appearance: Massive blue-skinned giant with dignified armor and storm-wreathed hair.
secrets: Has come to check state of desecrated Annam shrine.
npc_kraddokk.motivation: Preserve sanctity of giant holy sites.

knowledge_of_threads.thread_competing_giants: Fully aware of giant infighting; sees mortals as bargaining chips.

npc_kraddokk.dm_notes: His attitude determines if party leaves with a curse or a friend. Roleplay wisdom and gravitas.

faction_dragon_cult.name: Cult of the Dragon
faction_dragon_cult.ideology: Dragons are rightful rulers of the world—the strong must guide the rest.
faction_dragon_cult.dm_notes: Cult influence felt through hidden traps and cursed deposits. No overt leadership present.

faction_giants.name: Giantkind (Hill, Stone, Frost, Fire, Storm)
faction_giants.ideology: Supremacy and order via strength and accomplishment.
faction_giants.size: scores of giants and hundreds of minions
current_plans: Collect caches as proofs of strength
faction_giants.dm_notes: Clans not unified—party actions can affect future giant alliances.

faction_true_nimbus.name: Clan True-Nimbus
faction_true_nimbus.ideology: Only the cloud giants deserve to rule among giants.
faction_true_nimbus.dm_notes: Leave mocking notes, plant traps for rivals.

faction_adventurers_league.name: Adventurers League
faction_adventurers_league.ideology: Support heroes, write legends, prevent misuse of power.
faction_adventurers_league.dm_notes: Bestow rewards (downtime, reputation, assistance) to successful participants.

conseq_veradda_death.effect: Party forced to operate without her guidance; giants and rivals alerted to cache search.
conseq_veradda_death.potential_payoff: Caches found, with greater risk and competition.
conseq_veradda_death.dm_notes: Sets the plot in motion. Allows for hooks into rival parties.

conseq_giants_rivalry.trigger: Any cache is looted or evidence of giant infighting found.
conseq_giants_rivalry.effect: Giant attention increases; may result in direct confrontation.
conseq_giants_rivalry.potential_payoff: Potential alliances or curses, increased stakes.
conseq_giants_rivalry.dm_notes: Player decisions may shift party standing among giants.

conseq_elemental_fire.trigger: Immix symbol remains active or adventurers rest in forge.
conseq_elemental_fire.effect: Magmin and other fire creatures attack increasingly.
conseq_elemental_fire.potential_payoff: Hard-fought treasure, possible magical boons if fire is properly dealt with.
conseq_elemental_fire.dm_notes: Fire threat persists until symbol is deactivated. Danger increases with delay.

conseq_frost_magic.trigger: Party succumbs to or disables greed curse in icy chamber.
conseq_frost_magic.effect: Victims may later be stunned by great wealth, possibly cause party strife.
conseq_frost_magic.potential_payoff: Can be removed with magic or roleplay; introduces extra party complication.
conseq_frost_magic.dm_notes: Award Victim of Greed story in notes.

conseq_shrine_sanctity.trigger: Party attempts to loot or desecrate Annam's shrine.
conseq_shrine_sanctity.effect: If party steals gold plates or disrespects shrine, they are cursed by giants.
conseq_shrine_sanctity.potential_payoff: Gain loot OR earn favor of Kraddokk and future giant allies.
conseq_shrine_sanctity.dm_notes: Hated by Giants or Friend of Kraddokk story award.

giant_attention.description: Tracks how much the party has attracted giantkind's interest.
giant_attention.changes_when: Caches looted, shrines desecrated, or giants confronted.

fire_alert.description: Counts magmin waves based on party speed in the fire outpost.
fire_alert.changes_when: Resting or time spent in forge room.

magmin_wave_timer.description: Time between magmin attacks in forge room.

curse_reversal.description: Time until shrinking curse on Slayermighty and bear wears off.
curse_reversal.ticks_when: After defeat or delay in the cave chamber.
curse_reversal.on_expire: Slayermighty returns to giant size, bear dies unless saved.

trigger_conditions: Entering southern tunnel of Beneath the Hills
encounter_swarm_goblins.description: Swarm of mouse-sized cursed goblins attacks from the dark.
encounter_swarm_goblins.dm_notes: Play up chaos of darkness and corpse growth; possible additional swarms for stronger parties.

trigger_conditions: Crossing stone field at Upon the Stones
encounter_giant_badgers.description: Pack of giant badgers ambushes intruders.
enemy_composition: giant badger x5 (adjust for party size)
encounter_giant_badgers.dm_notes: Calm with DC 20 Handle Animal; can avoid some combat if succeeded.

trigger_conditions: Entering ice chamber with greed diamond
encounter_greed_motes.description: Greed motes linked to cursed diamond appear on failed saves.
encounter_greed_motes.dm_notes: Diamond must be destroyed to end combat; motes are otherwise invulnerable.

trigger_conditions: Attempting to bypass or deactivate Immix glyph in Fires outpost
encounter_magmin.description: Magmin spawn every 5 minutes or after combat defeat while fire symbol is active.
encounter_magmin.dm_notes: Deactivating Immix stops spawns; increase number for long delays.

encounter_giant_owl.description: Giant owls attack to defend the path—as servants of Kraddokk.
encounter_giant_owl.dm_notes: Increase/decrease number for party size or strength.

plotbranch_steal_shrine_plates.condition: Party removes one or more gold plates from Annam's shrine.
plotbranch_steal_shrine_plates.new_objective: Escape mountain while cursed and pursued by giantkind.
plotbranch_steal_shrine_plates.narrative_impact: Party is marked as desecrators, Hated by Giants story award, future giant hostility.
plotbranch_steal_shrine_plates.dm_notes: Tie-in to later campaigns or league play; future giants prioritize attacks on cursed party members.

plotbranch_save_blooddrinker.condition: Party rescues and tames the shrunken bear, Blooddrinker.
plotbranch_save_blooddrinker.new_objective: Player may keep Blooddrinker as a loyal, tiny pet.
plotbranch_save_blooddrinker.narrative_impact: Story award gives reputation for bear-saving; special interactions possible.
plotbranch_save_blooddrinker.dm_notes: Bear can't fight or aid in combat but is a charming companion; roleplay downtime training as desired.

plotbranch_befriend_kraddokk.condition: Party converses with Kraddokk and shows respect for Annam's shrine.
plotbranch_befriend_kraddokk.new_objective: Earn the storm giant's favor; potential boons or alliances.
plotbranch_befriend_kraddokk.narrative_impact: Friend of Kraddokk story award; possible future rescue or information.
plotbranch_befriend_kraddokk.dm_notes: Friendship may affect future league modules.
